language: Use case: style-transfer. Generate a companion LANGUAGE SELECTION illustration for this existing Muslim app onboarding set. Input images are STYLE REFERENCES only, not targets for replacement. Match their friendly flat 2D editorial cartoon art: clean simplified geometric silhouettes, restrained line details, minimal flat cel shading, peach and brown skin, muted deep teal and green, warm coral, pale blue/pastel sage shapes, small white diamond sparkles. Scene: two friendly Muslim adults, a man in a teal tunic and white cap and a woman in a coral hijab and teal dress, shown waist-up facing slightly toward each other. Between and above them are two small cream speech bubbles, one containing exactly the single Latin letter 'A', the other containing exactly the single Arabic letter 'ع'. This communicates choosing English or Arabic. The two people and conversation form one balanced connected illustration, with a pale blue organic arch-shaped backplate, matching the welcome reference. Modest attire; simple natural hands. Square illustration intended to be displayed at 220px on a phone, generous shapes and low complexity. Keep the whole scene inside the frame with 8% margin. True transparent alpha PNG background outside the shaped pastel backplate, not a solid rectangle; never draw a checkerboard. No additional text, no watermark, no app frame or button, no glossy 3D, no photorealism, no realistic shading or gradients. Preserve all original references unchanged.
notifications: Use case: style-transfer. Create a matching companion illustration for an existing Muslim app onboarding collection. The attached images are STYLE REFERENCES only; preserve them unchanged and create the new notification scene described here. Match their friendly flat 2D editorial cartoon illustration, clean simplified shapes, light hand-drawn contours, limited cel shading, peach skin, deep muted teal, sage green, coral, warm gold and pale blue organic/Islamic arch backdrop. Scene: a modestly dressed Muslim man in a white prayer cap and teal-green tunic, shown waist-up, calmly holding a smartphone and seeing a prayer reminder. Beside the phone is one warm-gold notification bell with two small curved ringing marks. Behind him, a pale sage mosque-arch silhouette with a crescent and a few small sparkles, consistent with the prayer and charity reference illustrations. The person, phone and bell form one simple coherent scene, not a collection of disconnected icons. Use simple natural hands. Asset type: large centered onboarding illustration, square 1024x1024, all objects fully within frame with about 8% transparent margin. Genuinely transparent PNG background outside the shaped pastel arch, preserve alpha; no solid rectangular background, no checkerboard baked in. Do not include words, lettering, UI screenshots, photorealism, 3D, gradients, glows, watermarks or logos. Keep the style at the same flat illustrated level as the references. The art must be readable on light and dark app backgrounds.
